messages:
ashley: heads-up — Copperfield private/VPC change window tomorrow 02:00 UTC (3h slot). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/copperfield-deploy. Who's on the window? Reply with role/coverage and ACK.

ashley: quick goals — push model runtime 1.14.2, enable KV cache toggle, smoke + latency check, rollback readiness. No DB migrations.

mike: I can lead the deploy. I'll be online 01:30 UTC for preflight. Will run smoke suite and validate inference correctness. ACK.

jia: I'll do rollback prep (playbooks + feature toggles) and watch logs/metrics during smoke. Oncall handoff at 01:45. ACK.

rafi: I'll handle infra pieces (VPC routing sanity, config sync, SRE toggles). Prepared rollback job to drain nodes if needed. ACK.

deploy-bot: reserve confirmed — slot 02:00-05:00 UTC. Ticket RW-4521 attached. :calendar:.

ashley: tiny preflight checklist (paste for easy copy):
```
# preflight checks (run by 01:40 UTC)
kubectl get pods -n copperfield | grep runtime
curl -sS https://copperfield.internal/health || echo HEALTH_FAIL
aws ec2 describe-instances --filters 'Name=tag:env,Values=prod'
# smoke scenario (run after rollout)
curl -sS -X POST https://api.copperfield.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}' | jq .text
```

mike: noted. PR #342 contains the runtime bump + config. @ashley can you review before EOD? small changes only.

ashley: will review tonight, expect comments by 22:00 PT. If anything blocks, ping in this thread.

jia: rollback plan summary: restore previous image tag -> copperfield/runtime:1.13.7, disable KV cache toggle, and switch traffic using nginx canary route. If error rate > 1% for 10m OR 95th latency > 1s, trigger rollback.

rafi: infra rollback command (keeps node pools intact):
```
# quick rollback (infra)
kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=copperfield/runtime:1.13.7 -n copperfield
kubectl rollout status deployment/runtime -n copperfield --watch
```

mike: smoke assertions I'll run post-deploy: 50 sample prompts -> mean latency < 350ms, top-1 token diff rate < 0.8%. I'll attach results.

ashley: logging hooks: please enable trace sampling at 1% for the window (temp change). Link to ops checkbox: https://redwood.internal/ops/checklists/copperfield.

rafi: I'll keep a CloudWatch dashboard open and DM alerts to #eng-oncall if anything spikes.

ashley: please ACK the specific times: preflight 01:30, handoff 01:45, deploy 02:00, smoke 02:10-02:30.

mike: ACK for those times. I'll DM 15m before and when I start the rollout.

jia: ACK. I'll post rollback ready timestamp when done prepping ~01:50.

ashley: one last note — fallback model variant is copper-mini-v1 (lower cost, compatible). If we see token errors or OOMs, switch traffic to copper-mini-v1 and follow rollback steps.

mike: got it. I'll also add a quick smoke script to the PR so it's reproducible.

ashley: thanks — small request: anyone who is not able to join, please update this thread so we can reassign. Otherwise we assume the ACKs above. :thumbsup:

rafi: plan looks good. I'll be standing by in the channel during the window.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled — automated post-deploy alert will run at 02:35 UTC to summary metrics.

ashley: perfect. I'll close prep at 01:55 and share a one-line status here before deploy.

mike: cool — see you all tomorrow.
